title: Fix AuthRepository.currentUuid race condition — cache Future, not value
objective: Eliminate the race where two concurrent callers of AuthRepository.currentUuid each see `String? _currentUuid == null` and both kick off a SharedPreferences read; cache the in-flight Future<String?> so all concurrent callers await the same promise.
description: AuthRepository (lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart) currently exposes `Future<String?> get currentUuid async`. The getter body (lines 63-69) checks `if (_currentUuid != null) return _currentUuid;` then awaits `_fetchTokenAndUuid()` and returns the cached value. Two concurrent callers (e.g. the router redirect and the HomeCubit during the same frame) both see `_currentUuid == null` before either completes the SharedPreferences read, so they both call `_fetchTokenAndUuid()`. Worse: caller B's `_fetchTokenAndUuid()` may overwrite caller A's `_authToken` write mid-flight. The fix replaces the `String? _currentUuid` cache with `Future<String?>? _currentUuidFuture`, returns the same Future to every concurrent caller, and resolves `_currentUuidFuture` only when the SharedPreferences read completes. The same pattern applies symmetrically to `Future<bool> get isAuthenticated` if desired — recommended, because the same race exists there.

anchors: lines 33-51 — _fetchTokenAndUuid() (KEEP — but it must NOT mutate _currentUuid directly; instead it returns the resolved value)
lines 53-60 — Future<bool> get isAuthenticated (REWRITE — apply the Future-cache pattern symmetrically; see fix_shape)
lines 62-69 — Future<String?> get currentUuid (REWRITE — see fix_shape)

reference_files.reason: Source for the interface — kept byte-identical. Public surface does not change.

fix_shape._fetchTokenAndUuid: Refactor to Future<String?> _fetchTokenAndUuid() that does the SharedPreferences reads, mutates the private _authToken field only after both reads succeed, and returns the resolved uuid (or null).
fix_shape.isAuthenticated_getter: Future<bool> get isAuthenticated { return _isAuthenticatedFuture ??= _fetchTokenAndUuid().then((uuid) => uuid != null && (uuid.isNotEmpty)); }
fix_shape.logout_and_validateSession_invalidation: After logout (line 222) and after validateSession() failure (lines 85-92), set both Future fields back to null so the next call re-reads from SharedPreferences.

acceptance_criteria: _currentUuid field is no longer a String? — it is replaced by _currentUuidFuture (Future<String?>?)
The currentUuid getter returns the cached Future on every concurrent call after the first — verified by code inspection: `return _currentUuidFuture ??= _fetchTokenAndUuid();`
Two concurrent callers of currentUuid share the same in-flight SharedPreferences read — no longer two parallel reads
isAuthenticated getter applies the same Future-cache pattern
logout() sets _currentUuidFuture = null and _isAuthenticatedFuture = null AFTER the SharedPreferencesService writes return
validateSession() sets both Future fields back to null when the session is cleared (lines 85-92 already mutate fields; add the Future invalidation alongside)
Public behavior of login / signUp / validateSession / logout / resetPassword is unchanged
flutter analyze lib/data/repositories/auth/ returns no errors

grep_evidence: rg -n '_currentUuidFuture|_isAuthenticatedFuture' lib/data/repositories/auth/auth_repository.dart must return at least 4 matches (field decl + getter + 2 invalidations)
validation.race_test_pattern: Add a comment in the source explaining the Future-cache pattern (e.g. `// Concurrent callers share the same in-flight read; do NOT replace this with a value cache.`).

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch IAuthRepository. Do not touch SharedPreferencesService. Do not touch the change-notifier behavior (M5 will refactor that separately).
